findings.title: FortiGuard PSIRT advisory FG-IR-26-194: origin validation error in the FortiClient local API endpoint
findings.summary_md: Fortinet's own advisory, published November 10, 2026, describes an origin validation error [CWE-346] in the FortiClient Mac, FortiClient Windows, and FortiClient Windows PAM local API endpoint that may let an unauthorized remote attacker execute code or commands, with exploitation requiring interaction with the victim. The page carries CVE-2026-121529, severity critical, CVSSv3 9.1, attack type unauthenticated, and Known Exploited: No. FortiClientMac 7.4.0 through 7.4.7 and FortiClientWindows and FortiClientWindowsPAM 7.4.0 through 7.4.7 move to 7.4.8 or above, while the 7.2 branch moves from 7.2.0 through 7.2.14 to 7.2.15 or above. The advisory credits Kevin Joensen of Baldur Security for the report under responsible disclosure and records the initial publication on 2026-11-10.

findings.title: FortiGuard PSIRT advisory FG-IR-26-199: unauthenticated FortiMail path traversal to code execution
findings.summary_md: Advisory FG-IR-26-199, published November 10, 2026, covers CVE-2026-126147, a path traversal [CWE-22] in FortiMail rated 9.8 that lets an unauthenticated attacker execute code or commands with crafted requests. FortiMail 8.0.0 through 8.0.1 moves to 8.0.2, 7.6.0 through 7.6.6 moves to 7.6.7, 7.4.0 through 7.4.8 moves to 7.4.9, and the whole 7.2 branch has no fix and is directed to migrate. The advisory states Fortinet had already remediated the issue in FortiMail Cloud on October 5, 2026 by moving cloud firmwares to v7.6.7 GA or v8.0.2 GA.

findings.title: FortiGuard PSIRT advisory FG-IR-26-200: unauthenticated FortiMail command injection via HA join-request packets
findings.summary_md: Advisory FG-IR-26-200, published November 10, 2026, covers CVE-2026-126148, a command injection [CWE-77] in FortiMail rated 9.8 that an unauthenticated attacker reaches through crafted high-availability join-request packets. FortiMail 8.0 and 7.6 are affected, with 8.0.0 through 8.0.1 fixed in 8.0.2 and 7.6.0 through 7.6.6 fixed in 7.6.7, while the 7.4 and 7.2 branches are listed as not affected. As with the sibling FortiMail advisories, FortiMail Cloud was already remediated on October 5, 2026.

findings.title: FortiGuard PSIRT advisory FG-IR-26-202: unauthenticated IBE webmail password reset and account takeover in FortiMail
findings.summary_md: Advisory FG-IR-26-202, published November 10, 2026, covers CVE-2026-126150, a missing authentication for critical function [CWE-306] in FortiMail rated 9.1 that lets an unauthenticated attacker reset the password of an arbitrary IBE webmail user and take over the account with crafted HTTP requests. FortiMail 8.0.0 moves to 8.0.1, 7.6.0 through 7.6.5 moves to 7.6.6, 7.4.0 through 7.4.7 moves to 7.4.8, and 7.2.0 through 7.2.9 moves to the then-upcoming 7.2.10. The advisory notes FortiMail Cloud was remediated on October 5, 2026.

findings.title: FortiGuard PSIRT advisory FG-IR-26-219: unauthenticated code execution in the FortiAnalyzer and FortiManager GUI
findings.summary_md: Advisory FG-IR-26-219, published November 10, 2026, covers CVE-2026-126170, an improper encoding or escaping of output [CWE-116] rated 9.8 in the FortiSASE-Sovereign, FortiAnalyzer, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer Cloud, FortiManager Cloud, and FortiAnalyzer Big-Data web interfaces that lets an unauthenticated attacker execute code with a crafted HTTP request. FortiAnalyzer 8.0.0 through 8.0.2 and FortiAnalyzer Cloud 8.0.1 through 8.0.2 are fixed in the upcoming 8.0.3 or by applying a workaround, and FortiAnalyzer 7.6.0 through 7.6.7 moves to 7.6.8, with 7.4 and 7.2 listed as not affected. This is the highest-scoring unauthenticated web-path flaw in the November 10 batch.

findings.title: FortiGuard PSIRT advisory FG-IR-26-265: FortiAuthenticator authorization bypass to unauthorized access
findings.summary_md: Advisory FG-IR-26-265, published November 10, 2026, covers CVE-2026-126251, an incorrect authorization [CWE-863] in FortiAuthenticator rated 9.1 that allows an attacker to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access. FortiAuthenticator 8.0.0 through 8.0.3 moves to 8.0.4 and 6.6.0 through 6.6.10 moves to 6.6.11. The acknowledgement credits Gwendal Guegniaud of the Fortinet Product Security team for an internal discovery made with the use of the frontier AI model Claude Mythos, one of many advisories in this batch with the same credit.

findings.title: FortiGuard PSIRT advisory FG-IR-26-273: FortiOS HA FGSP command execution as super admin
findings.summary_md: Advisory FG-IR-26-273, published November 10, 2026, covers CVE-2026-126259, a missing authentication for critical function [CWE-306] in FortiOS rated 9.0 that lets an unauthenticated attacker running against a cluster configured with HA FGSP and standalone-config-sync, or with autoscale, execute commands as super admin through crafted HA packets. FortiOS 8.0.0 moves to 8.0.1, 7.6.0 through 7.6.7 moves to 7.6.8, 7.4.0 through 7.4.12 moves to 7.4.13, and 7.2.0 through 7.2.13 moves to 7.2.14, with the upgrade path tool referenced for sequencing. The flaw sits in the internal cluster protocol rather than the management or SSL-VPN surface.

findings.title: FortiGuard PSIRT advisory FG-IR-26-275: unauthenticated FortiManager FGFM code execution
findings.summary_md: Advisory FG-IR-26-275, published November 10, 2026, covers CVE-2026-126261, an improper authorization in the FortiManager FGFM service rated 9.0 that lets an unauthenticated attacker able to reach the FGFM port execute code or commands with crafted FGFM packets. FortiManager 8.0.0 moves to 8.0.1, 7.6.0 through 7.6.7 moves to 7.6.8, 7.4.0 through 7.4.5 moves to 7.4.6, and 7.2.0 through 7.2.8 moves to 7.2.9. The acknowledgement credits Theo Leleu of the Fortinet Product Security team with the use of the frontier AI model Claude Mythos.

findings.title: FortiGuard PSIRT advisory FG-IR-26-276: unauthenticated OFTP SQL injection in FortiAnalyzer and FortiManager
findings.summary_md: Advisory FG-IR-26-276, published November 10, 2026, covers CVE-2026-126262, a SQL injection [CWE-89] rated 9.3 in FortiAnalyzer or FortiManager with FortiAnalyzer features that lets an unauthenticated attacker who can reach the oftp port execute code or commands with crafted OFTP packets. FortiAnalyzer 8.0.0 through 8.0.1 moves to 8.0.2, 7.6.0 through 7.6.7 moves to 7.6.8, 7.4.0 through 7.4.11 moves to 7.4.12, and 7.2.0 through 7.2.12 moves to 7.2.13, with FortiManager 8.0.0 and 7.6.0 through 7.6.7 also listed. A companion advisory, FG-IR-26-274, covers CVE-2026-126260, a server-side request forgery [CWE-918] rated 9.0 on the same oftp port.

findings.title: HKCERT security bulletin: Fortinet products, multiple vulnerabilities
findings.summary_md: HKCERT published this bulletin on November 11, 2026 under reference 20261111, cataloguing the Fortinet advisory wave by linking the individual PSIRT entries FG-IR-26-190 through the later numbers in the batch and rating the aggregate risk medium. The bulletin states a remote attacker could exploit some of the flaws for denial of service, elevation of privilege, security restriction bypass, sensitive information disclosure, remote code execution, data manipulation and spoofing. It is a regional CERT acknowledgement of the batch and carries no exploitation telemetry.
